page_title: BOU 0-0 NEW | Bournemouth v Newcastle 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' High and wide! James Hill (Bournemouth) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+2' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+2' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.

90+1' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom right corner, but Nick Pope denies him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Handball by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd). Bournemouth have a free kick from a promising distance.
89' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
89' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
88' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
84' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. William Osula (Newcastle Utd) replaces Nick Woltemade.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Malick Thiaw cannot continue after picking up an injury.

82' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends in a cross from a free kick from just outside the box, trying to find one of his teammates deep inside the penalty area. The goalkeeper displays great anticipation and collects the ball.
80' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Bournemouth win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
80' A clumsy foul by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
79' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' James Hill (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
77' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) for a tough tackle.
75' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
74' Bafode Diakite (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Robert Jones after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
74' The resulting corner from Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
74' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Newcastle earn a corner.
72' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Nick Woltemade, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
71' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
70' 8:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
69' James Hill (Bournemouth) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
66' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
63' It will be a substitution. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is ready to enter the pitch as David Brooks walks off.
63' A substitution has been made. Alex Scott is replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
62' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Jacob Murphy will be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
62' Substitution. Joe Willock leaves the pitch and is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
62' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
61' The ball is cleared after Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
59' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
57' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
54' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
52' One of the Newcastle players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
48' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' Half-time substitution. Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) will not participate anymore and James Hill is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth).
45+2' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
45+2' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
45+1' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
41' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
39' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) sends a chip pass into the box, but Djordje Petrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
38' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
34' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
32' The game is interrupted now, Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' David Brooks (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
29' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Jones blows for a foul. Free kick. Bournemouth will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

27' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.

25' That was close by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
22' The linesman signals that Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
18' David Brooks (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Robert Jones stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
17' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
15' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. David Brooks (Bournemouth) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
12' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is flagged for offside.
12' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Djordje Petrovic (Bournemouth).
11' Djordje Petrovic pulls off a great save to deny Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
9' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Nick Pope.
7' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' David Brooks (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It's a throw-in for Bournemouth.
5' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Djordje Petrovic punches the ball away.
2' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Robert Jones got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
